in_marathi.name: Bivas
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Living
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bivas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bivas is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bhiva', which means 'living'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is the preserver and sustainer of the universe. The name Bivas signifies the one who preserves and sustains life, and is therefore considered a powerful and spiritual name.
